3899-4488-7084.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-5399-6913.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-5399-6913.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Chameleon and Pirated Copy each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Chameleon trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Pirated Copy trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-5399-6913.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

877-3081-3817-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Morophon.
When Morophon dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Morophon from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2525-3763-6749-6798.easyPrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
2525-3763-6749-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Anticausal Vestige.
When Anticausal Vestige dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Body Double from your hand onto the battlefield tapped. Choose to have Body Double enter as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
When Body Double enters, Paleoloth triggers, returning Anticausal Vestige from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Body Double.
When Body Double dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Paleoloth triggers, returning Body Double from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

240-2292-5470-7296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat from step 2.

3220-6798-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
3220-6798-7084.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Golgari Germination and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

4976-5686-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
4976-5686-7084.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Open the Graves and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1651-3340-6753-6871.description:
Activate Bootleggers' Stash by tapping it, as it's a land due to Toph, creating two Treasure tokens due to Exalted Sunborn.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Bootleggers' Stash.
Repeat.

3690-4772-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
3690-4772-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Sylvan Awakening
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

277-3293-4693-5721.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
277-3293-4693-5721.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd and Tiller Engine trigger that many times.
Resolve all Tiller Engine triggers, untapping each land that entered.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
277-3293-4693-5721.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

56-3220-5256-6887.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-3220-5256-6887.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Golgari Germination and The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-3220-5256-6887.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

222-527-3480-6798.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3480-6798.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

224-872-3886.easyPrerequisites: You control up to three lands that enter the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {3}.
224-872-3886.description:
Activate three lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Soratami Mirror Mage by paying {3} and returning the three lands from the battlefield to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 1.
Resolve all Soratami Mirror-Mage abilities, returning any number of creatures from the battlefield to their owners' hands.
224-872-3886.notes: You can repeat this loop as desired to constantly return creatures to their owner's hands as they enter the battlefield.

1978-3430-3755.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact creature that does not have summoning sickness.
1978-3430-3755.description:
Activate an artifact creature by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the artifact creature.
Repeat.

2084-4711.easyPrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
2084-4711.description:
Declare Mirror-Mad Phantasm as an attacker.
Mirror-Mad Phantasm's myriad ability triggers, creating a token copy of itself tapped and attacking each other opponent.
Activate a Mirror-Mad Phantasm token by paying {1}{U}, causing you to shuffle it into your library, then reveal and mill your entire library due to not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

413-2577-6462.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

645-1267-2034-3908.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-2034-3908.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Spark Double from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Spark Double.
Spark Double triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Spark Double
Repeat each turn.

222-527-1753-5256.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-1753-5256.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1116-3240-5670-5933.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1116-3240-5670-5933.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Popular Egotist and Sek'Kuar trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Popular Egotist and Nether Traitor trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Nether Traitor trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

283-2816-4183-5116.notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers and Umbral Mantle attached to Saheeli.
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
283-2816-4183-5116.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, targeting Gilded Lotus.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Saheeli's ability, targeting Gilded Lotus.
Resolve both Saheeli abilities, creating two token copies of Gilded Lotus.
Activate both Gilded Lotus tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}{U}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Saheeli by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other artifact/creature using Saheeli's ability.

224-872-2232.notablePrerequisites: You have a nonartifact land card in hand.
224-872-2232.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting a nonartifact land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm and  Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning any other nonartifact land from the battlefield to your hand.
If the land entered untapped and can produce mana, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat.

1914-2456-2500-4659-4840.description:
Cast Myr Battlesphere by paying at most {4}.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks three times by sacrificing the Myr tokens, adding six {C}.
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, targeting Myr Battlesphere.
Cowardice triggers, returning Myr Battlepshere from the battlefield to your hand.
Mirage Mirror's ability fails to resolve  due to no longer having a legal target.
Repeat.

796-2100-2440-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Zombies.
796-2100-2440-4050.description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {4}{R}.
Poppet Stitcher triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
The Zombie enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Searing Touch, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Searing Touch to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1308-2034-2162-2308.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1308-2034-2162-2308.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two creatures, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
The creatures die, triggering Soul Net twice.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to pay {1} to gain 1 life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create two 4/4 Fungus Beast creature tokens.
Repeat.

1003-2034-4535-5224.description:
Cast Phyrexian Walker.
Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phyrexian Walker.
 Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, making it so the next time Phyrexian Walker dies this turn, it returns to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, adding {2}.
Together Forever triggers, returning Phyrexian Walker to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

224-280-1993.notablePrerequisites: You control fewer than nine lands.
224-280-1993.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Budoka Gardener.
Repeat.

2686-4274-5276.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, exiling Barren Glory.
Cast Apocalypse by paying {2}{R}{R}{R}, exiling all permanents and causing you to discard your hand.
Leonin Relic-Warder triggers, returning Barren Glory to the battlefield.
Proceed to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Barren Glory triggers, causing you to win the game.
